SMS Consent and Messaging Information

Effective November 25, 2026.

John Crawford Company sends text messages only to people who choose to receive them. This page explains how that choice is made and what to expect.

How Website Visitors Opt In

Visitors opt in through the contact and quote forms on www.johncrawfordcompany.com and on these go.johncrawfordcompany.com pages. Each form has two independent, optional checkboxes, both unchecked by default:

  • Service texts: “I agree to receive service texts from John Crawford Company about consultations, appointments, estimates, installations, repairs, and customer support.”
  • Promotional texts: “I agree to receive promotional texts from John Crawford Company about offers and product news.”

Next to the checkboxes, the form states: Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. The form also links to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

Consent Is Specific and Voluntary

You can submit a form without selecting either checkbox, and you can choose service texts, promotional texts, both or neither. Selecting one checkbox gives consent only to that category. Consent is not a condition of purchase. We record each choice with the date, time and page where it was made.

Mobile Information and Sharing

John Crawford Company does not sell, rent, lease, or share SMS opt-in data, phone numbers, or consent records with third parties or affiliates for their marketing or promotional purposes. Our customer-relationship platform processes records only on our behalf, and subcontractors and service providers that support customer service, scheduling, website operations, or message delivery receive information only as needed to provide those services. See our Privacy Policy.

Message Types

Service (transactional) texts may cover consultations, appointments, estimates, scheduling, project updates, installations, repairs, and customer support.

Promotional texts may cover offers, discounts, product announcements, and seasonal promotions.

Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP at any time to opt out, or HELP for help. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
